Name: Better Gemstones Animated
Author: undare
Description:
[center][b][size=5][color=#8e7cc3]Better[/color] [color=#c27ba0]Gems[/color] [color=#6fa8dc]and[/color] [color=#f6b26b]Minerals[/color] [color=#ffe599]Animated[/color][/size]

[size=4]With the permission of [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/38715215?tab=user+files]cometkins[/url]﻿[size=4]:[/size]
[size=4]I added some shines and glows to 57 items of his  "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5443]Better Gems and Minerals[/url]﻿" mod[/size]
[size=4] (Should be 58, but Mudstone was not animated.)[/size]


[size=4]With the config file inside, you can turn on or off any of the 57 items inside (Default all to [color=#a4c2f4]true[/color]).
[/size]

[size=4]This mod is compatible with [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4986]Animated Gemstones[/url]﻿[size=4] as long as you turn on only 1 from both mods at the same time.[/size]
[size=4]Turning 2 same stones[/size][size=4] at the same time, might cause flickering or an [color=#dd7e6b]error[/color] log.[/size]


[size=4]For easier managment of the [color=#b6d7a8]config[/color] file, you can install : [/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b][size=4]generic mod Config Menu[/size][/b][/url][b][size=4]﻿  [/size]
[size=4]So you can edit the config inside the game.  (bottom left corner, A gear icon,)[/size]


[size=5][color=#6d9eeb]Installation[/color][/size]
[size=4]Download/unpack the requirements above [/size]
[size=4]Download/unpack this mod inside stardewvalley/mods folder[/size]



[b][color=#f6b26b]Note[/color]: The "Gems screenshot/gif" has some colore changed because some gif problems.
The colors remain the same as in the original mod.[/b]
[/b][/center][b][size=4]
[/size][/b]
